## Chuẩn bị dữ liệu

```{r}
df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Tính tuổi từ năm sinh
    tuoi = 2026 - nam_sinh,
    
    # 1. Phân độ gan nhiễm mỡ (Steatosis Grades)
    muc_do_nhiem_mo = case_when(
      cap < 244 ~ "S0",
      cap >= 244 & cap < 269 ~ "S1",
      cap >= 269 & cap < 296 ~ "S2",
      cap >= 296 ~ "S3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # 2. Phân độ xơ hóa (Fibrosis Grades - Tạm dùng cut-off FibroScan)
    muc_do_xo_hoa = case_when(
      fibro < 8.0 ~ "F0-F1",
      fibro >= 8.0 & fibro < 12.0 ~ "F2",
      fibro >= 12.0 & fibro < 20.0 ~ "F3",
      fibro >= 20.0 ~ "F4",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # 3. Yếu tố RLCH (Biến 0/1)
    co_rlch = if_else(
      (gioi == 1 & vong_eo_90_m_80_f >= 90) | (gioi == 0 & vong_eo_90_m_80_f >= 80) |
      glucose_100_mg_dl >= 100 |
      hba1c_5_7_percent >= 5.7| 
      dtd2 == 1 |
      tha == 1 |
      ha_130_85 == 1 |
      triglyceride_150_5mg_dl >= 150.5 |
      (gioi == 1 & hdl_40_m_50_f <= 40) | (gioi == 0 & hdl_40_m_50_f <= 50) |
      thuoc_lipid == 1,
      1, 0
    ),
    
    TyG = log(triglyceride_150_5mg_dl * glucose_100_mg_dl / 2),
    
    TyG_BMI = TyG * bmi,
    
    bgnmlqrlch_chuan_doan = if_else(cap >= 244 & co_rlch == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    bgnmlqrlch_binary = if_else(cap >= 244 & co_rlch == 1, 1, 0),
    
    nhiem_mo_s2_plus = if_else(cap >= 269, 1, 0),
    xo_hoa_f2_plus = if_else(fibro >= 8.0, 1, 0)
  )
```

## Violin plots

```{r fig.path="figures/", fig.width=10, fig.height=7, fig.dpi=300}
library(ggh4x) 

df_violin_grid <- df_clean %>%
  select(bgnmlqrlch_binary, nhiem_mo_s2_plus, xo_hoa_f2_plus, ty_g_wc_index, fli_index, TyG_BMI, TyG) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(bgnmlqrlch_binary, nhiem_mo_s2_plus, xo_hoa_f2_plus),
    names_to = "Outcome_Type",
    values_to = "Outcome_Value"
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ty_g_wc_index, fli_index, TyG_BMI, TyG),
    names_to = "Index_Name",
    values_to = "Index_Value"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Outcome_Value, Index_Value) %>%
  
  mutate(

    Outcome_Value = factor(Outcome_Value, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),

    Outcome_Type = factor(Outcome_Type,
                          levels = c("bgnmlqrlch_binary", "nhiem_mo_s2_plus", "xo_hoa_f2_plus"),
                          labels = c("MASLD", "Steatosis", "Fibrosis")),

    Index_Name = factor(Index_Name,
                        levels = c("TyG", "TyG_BMI", "ty_g_wc_index", "fli_index"),
                        labels = c("TyG", "TyG-BMI", "TyG-WC", "FLI"))
  )

ggplot(df_violin_grid, aes(x = Outcome_Value, y = Index_Value, fill = Outcome_Value)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, width = 0.5) +

  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "#589A99", "Yes" = "#FED3C2")) +

    strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = "gray"),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
```

## Odd Ratios by multivariate models

```{r}
export_full_table <- function(outcome_var, var_cont, var_quart, var_label, outcome_label) {

  m1_c <- logistf(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", var_cont)), data = df_model)
  m2_c <- logistf(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", var_cont, "+ tuoi + gioi")), data = df_model)
  m3_c <- logistf(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", var_cont, "+ tuoi + gioi + ggt + tha")), data = df_model)
  
  t1_c <- tbl_regression(m1_c, exponentiate = TRUE, include = all_of(var_cont))
  t2_c <- tbl_regression(m2_c, exponentiate = TRUE, include = all_of(var_cont))
  t3_c <- tbl_regression(m3_c, exponentiate = TRUE, include = all_of(var_cont))
  
  m1_q <- logistf(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", var_quart)), data = df_model)
  m2_q <- logistf(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", var_quart, "+ tuoi + gioi")), data = df_model)
  m3_q <- logistf(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", var_quart, "+ tuoi + gioi + ggt + tha")), data = df_model)
  
  t1_q <- tbl_regression(m1_q, exponentiate = TRUE, include = all_of(var_quart))
  t2_q <- tbl_regression(m2_q, exponentiate = TRUE, include = all_of(var_quart))
  t3_q <- tbl_regression(m3_q, exponentiate = TRUE, include = all_of(var_quart))
  
  t1_stacked <- tbl_stack(list(t1_c, t1_q))
  t2_stacked <- tbl_stack(list(t2_c, t2_q))
  t3_stacked <- tbl_stack(list(t3_c, t3_q))
  
  tbl_merge(
    tbls = list(t1_stacked, t2_stacked, t3_stacked),
    tab_spanner = c("**Model 1**", "**Model 2**", "**Model 3**")
  ) %>%
    modify_caption(paste("**Table: Association between", var_label, "and", outcome_label, "**")) %>%
    bold_labels()
}

export_full_table("bgnmlqrlch_binary", "ty_g_wc_index", "TyG_WC_Q", "TyG-WC", "MASLD")
export_full_table("bgnmlqrlch_binary", "TyG_BMI", "TyG_BMI_Q", "TyG-BMI", "MASLD")
export_full_table("bgnmlqrlch_binary", "TyG", "TyG_Q", "TyG", "MASLD")
export_full_table("bgnmlqrlch_binary", "fli_index", "FLI_Q", "FLI", "MASLD")

export_full_table("nhiem_mo_s2_plus", "ty_g_wc_index", "TyG_WC_Q", "TyG-WC", "Steatosis")
export_full_table("nhiem_mo_s2_plus", "TyG_BMI", "TyG_BMI_Q", "TyG-BMI", "Steatosis")
export_full_table("nhiem_mo_s2_plus", "TyG", "TyG_Q", "TyG", "Steatosis")
export_full_table("nhiem_mo_s2_plus", "fli_index", "FLI_Q", "FLI", "Steatosis")

export_full_table("xo_hoa_f2_plus", "ty_g_wc_index", "TyG_WC_Q", "TyG-WC", "Fibrosis")
export_full_table("xo_hoa_f2_plus", "TyG_BMI", "TyG_BMI_Q", "TyG-BMI", "Fibrosis")
export_full_table("xo_hoa_f2_plus", "TyG", "TyG_Q", "TyG", "Fibrosis")
```

## Mục tiêu 3

```{r fig.path="figures/", fig.width=10, fig.height=4, fig.dpi=300}
plot_roc_outcome <- function(outcome_col, plot_title) {
  
  roc_tyg     <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$TyG, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  roc_tyg_bmi <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$TyG_BMI, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  roc_tyg_wc  <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$ty_g_wc_index, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  roc_fli     <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$fli_index, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

  label_tyg    <- paste0("TyG (", sprintf("%.2f", roc_tyg$auc), ")")
  label_tygbmi <- paste0("TyG-BMI (", sprintf("%.2f", roc_tyg_bmi$auc), ")")
  label_tygwc  <- paste0("TyG-WC (", sprintf("%.2f", roc_tyg_wc$auc), ")")
  label_fli    <- paste0("FLI (", sprintf("%.2f", roc_fli$auc), ")")

  roc_list <- list(roc_tyg, roc_tyg_bmi, roc_tyg_wc, roc_fli)
  names(roc_list) <- c(label_tyg, label_tygbmi, label_tygwc, label_fli)

  my_colors <- c("#1B4F72", "#C0392B", "#27AE60", "#F39C12", "#006D6F")
  names(my_colors) <- c(label_tyg, label_tygbmi, label_tygwc, label_fli, "Reference")

  ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_abline(aes(color = "Reference"), intercept = 0, slope = 1, linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = my_colors) +
    labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", title = plot_title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#E5EFEF", linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
      
      legend.position = c(0.70, 0.22),
      legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_blank() 
    )
}

p_masld <- plot_roc_outcome("bgnmlqrlch_binary", "MASLD")
p_steatosis <- plot_roc_outcome("nhiem_mo_s2_plus", "Steatosis")
p_fibrosis <- plot_roc_outcome("xo_hoa_f2_plus", "Fibrosis")

(p_masld | p_steatosis | p_fibrosis)
```

```{r}
get_performance <- function(roc_obj, index_name, ref_roc = NULL) {
  auc_val <- roc_obj$auc
  ci_str  <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", roc_obj$ci[1]), "-", sprintf("%.2f", roc_obj$ci[3]))
  
  c_best <- coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden", 
                   ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv"), transpose = FALSE)
  
  cutoff <- c_best$threshold[1]
  sen    <- c_best$sensitivity[1] * 100
  spe    <- c_best$specificity[1] * 100
  ppv    <- c_best$ppv[1] * 100
  npv    <- c_best$npv[1] * 100
  
  if (is.null(ref_roc)) { p_str <- "-" } else {
    p_val <- roc.test(roc_obj, ref_roc, method = "delong", quiet = TRUE)$p.value
    p_str <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
  }
  
  tibble(
    Index = index_name,
    AUROC = sprintf("%.2f", auc_val), `95% CI` = ci_str, `Cutoff Value` = sprintf("%.2f", cutoff),
    `SEN (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", sen), `SPE (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", spe),
    `PPV (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", ppv), `NPV (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", npv), `p Value` = p_str
  )
}

# Hàm chạy cho 1 Outcome (4 chỉ số)
get_outcome_perf_table <- function(outcome_col, outcome_label) {
  r_tyg <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$TyG, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  r_tygbmi <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$TyG_BMI, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  r_tygwc <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$ty_g_wc_index, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  r_fli <- roc(df_model[[outcome_col]], df_model$fli_index, ci = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  
  bind_rows(
    get_performance(r_tyg, "TyG index", r_fli),
    get_performance(r_tygbmi, "TyG-BMI", r_fli),
    get_performance(r_tygwc, "TyG-WC", r_fli),
    get_performance(r_fli, "FLI", NULL)
  ) %>%
    mutate(Outcome = outcome_label) %>%
    relocate(Outcome) # Đưa cột Outcome lên đầu
}

# Gom 3 bảng lại thành 1 bảng khổng lồ
full_perf_table <- bind_rows(
  get_outcome_perf_table("bgnmlqrlch_binary", "MASLD"),
  get_outcome_perf_table("nhiem_mo_s2_plus", "Steatosis"),
  get_outcome_perf_table("xo_hoa_f2_plus", "Fibrosis")
)

knitr::kable(full_perf_table, align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
             caption = "**Table 5: Diagnostic performance of non-invasive indices for 3 outcomes**")
```

## Restricted Cubic Splines

```{r}
dd <- datadist(df_model)
options(datadist = "dd")

create_rcs_grid <- function(outcome_var, grid_title) {
  
  plot_rcs_with_cutoff <- function(var_name, var_label) {
    f <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ rcs(", var_name, ", 3)"))
    fit <- lrm(f, data = df_model, penalty = 0.5)
    
    pred <- Predict(fit, name = var_name, fun = exp, ref.zero = TRUE)
    df_pred <- as.data.frame(pred)
    
    p1 <- quantile(df_model[[var_name]], 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    p99 <- quantile(df_model[[var_name]], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
    df_pred_filtered <- df_pred %>% filter(.data[[var_name]] >= p1 & .data[[var_name]] <= p99)
    
    ref_x <- df_pred_filtered %>% filter(yhat == min(yhat)) %>% pull(.data[[var_name]])
    ref_x <- ref_x[1] 
    
    cutoff_row <- df_pred_filtered %>% filter(.data[[var_name]] > ref_x, yhat >= 1.0) %>% slice(1)
    cutoff_val <- ifelse(nrow(cutoff_row) > 0, cutoff_row[[var_name]], NA)
    
    p <- ggplot(df_pred_filtered, aes(x = .data[[var_name]], y = yhat)) +
        geom_line(color = "#B2182B", linewidth = 1.2) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.2) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(x = var_label, y = "Odds Ratio (OR)") +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5)) +
        theme(
            axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
            axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)
        )
    
    if (!is.na(cutoff_val)) {
        p <- p + 
            annotate("point", x = cutoff_val, y = 1.0, color = "black", size = 3) +
            annotate("text", x = cutoff_val, y = 0.8, 
                     label = paste0("Ref: ", round(cutoff_val, 2)), 
                     color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, hjust = -0.1)
    }
    return(p)
  }
  
  p_tyg    <- plot_rcs_with_cutoff("TyG", "TyG")
  p_tygbmi <- plot_rcs_with_cutoff("TyG_BMI", "TyG-BMI")
  p_tygwc  <- plot_rcs_with_cutoff("ty_g_wc_index", "TyG-WC")
  p_fli    <- plot_rcs_with_cutoff("fli_index", "FLI")
  
  (p_tyg | p_tygbmi) / (p_tygwc | p_fli) + 
      plot_annotation(
          title = grid_title,
          theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5))
      )
}
```
